Subject: Request: incident response plan + SOC2 artifacts for vendor review

Aisha —

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As part of Helios Health's vendor onboarding we need the following to complete our security review: a current incident response plan (IRP) covering detection and notification steps, a mapping of SOC 2 control evidence (index), and any recent incident postmortems or IR exercises.

We have an internal timeline to finish vendor risk sign-off by 11/15. Can you confirm what you can provide this week and who on your side will be the point of contact if we have follow-up technical questions?

Also, we have a short SIG questionnaire that asks how you handle incident communication to downstream customers — happy to share it if useful.

Regards,
Luke Moore
Security Operations Lead
Helios Health

Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: IRP + evidence bundle uploaded — README + postmortem summary

Luke —

Per our timeline, I've uploaded a zipped evidence bundle and a short README to the shared drive. Contents: IRP v2 (irp_v2.pdf), SOC2 evidence index (soc2-evidence-index.csv), sanitized detection logs, retention policy export, postmortem summary (postmortem-summary-20261108.txt), and the Excel you sent with requested fields populated.

Readme excerpt on incident notification to customers (for SIG):
- External notifications: Primary contact list maintained per customer contract; notifications go to security distribution lists and an identified product contact for operational impact. For Helios we will send initial notifications to security@helioshealth.com and your named SOC contact.
- Initial SLA: We aim to send an initial incident notification within 2 hours of confirmed customer-impacting incidents (for high-severity incidents). Lower-severity events follow a 24-hour notification expectation after validation.
- Follow-ups/postmortem: We provide periodic status updates via email or a shared incident workspace until resolution. For incidents with broad customer impact we publish a post-incident summary after remediation and root cause analysis — the cadence is typically 7–14 days depending on investigative scope.

Download: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Helios/IRP-evidence-20261108 (evidence-bundle-Helios-20261108.zip)

If you'd like a short video walkthrough or a live session next week to go over the artifacts, I'm available Tues/Wed.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Solutions (Vendor Security)
Redwood Inference
